boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors immediately beside UNL City Campus, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: 12th Street: Free galleries
cards.subtitle: 12th Street corridor beside UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Walk to 12th and R for the galleries, then use the museum’s visitor guidance for entrances, current hours, and artwork-viewing rules.
cards.short_summary: A documented no-admission art stop beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheldon Museum of Art is at 451 North 12th Street on the UNL campus, and admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday at the hours listed by Sheldon; closed Monday and selected holidays.

cards.title: 12th Street: Live performance listings
cards.subtitle: 12th Street corridor beside UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Check the current calendar and ticket details before heading to the Lied Center; its official site identifies it as UNL City Campus’s arts presenter.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge venue for scheduled music, dance, theater, and Broadway presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lied Center, at 301 North 12th Street, presents professional Broadway productions, musicians, dance companies, theater companies, and orchestras.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions | Lied Center for Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Confirm the individual event’s ticket and arrival requirements through the official calendar or ticket office.

cards.entity_name: Mary Riepma Ross Media Arts Center
cards.title: 13th Street: Film calendar
cards.subtitle: 13th Street corridor beside UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Use The Ross’s event calendar to choose a screening, then check the listing for ticket and program details before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-adjacent cinema with an official screening calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ross’s official events page lists screenings and identifies the Mary Riepma Ross Media Arts Center at 313 North 13th Street.
cards.access_notes: Screening availability and admission vary by event; consult the official event listing.

cards.title: 14th Street: Public library resources
cards.subtitle: 14th Street corridor beside UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Bring a study task or browse the special collections at this downtown library; its location page lists public computers, Wi-Fi, and meeting spaces.
cards.short_summary: A city library stop two blocks south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Bennett Martin Public Library is at 136 South 14th Street, and Lincoln City Libraries lists free Wi-Fi, public computers, meeting spaces, and tech help among its services.
cards.source_title: Locations and Hours | Lincoln City Libraries
cards.access_notes: The library lists Monday–Thursday, Friday–Saturday, and Sunday operating hours; check for holiday closures.

cards.title: K Street: Free guided tours
cards.subtitle: K Street corridor between 14th and 16th Streets
cards.notes: Enter through the north entrance on the second floor for a guided tour, and check the Capitol page for day-specific times and tower conditions.
cards.short_summary: A state-government landmark with free daily guided tours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nebraska State Capitol at 1445 K Street offers free guided tours beginning at the north entrance on the second floor.
cards.access_notes: Building and tour hours vary by day; the observation decks can close for weather or construction.

cards.title: P Street: Hands-on exhibits
cards.subtitle: P Street corridor at 14th Street, south of UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Plan this stop for a child-and-caretaker outing; the museum describes three levels of hands-on exhibits and posts admission and entry policies online.
cards.short_summary: A downtown children’s museum with documented experiential-learning exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Lincoln Children’s Museum, at 1420 P Street, has 23,000 square feet of experiential-learning exhibits and posts admission rates.
cards.access_notes: Children must be accompanied by an adult; review current hours and admission before visiting.

cards.title: 7th & P: Saturday market
cards.subtitle: P Street corridor in the Historic Haymarket, west of UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Visit on a scheduled Saturday to browse vendors and the Iron Horse Park performances; the official event page gives the seasonal dates and market window.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal outdoor market with free admission in the Haymarket.
cards.evidence_claim: The Historic Haymarket Farmers’ Market runs Saturdays at 7th and P Street, lists free admission, and is scheduled May 2–October 10, 2026.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Saturdays, 8 a.m.–noon, May 2–October 10, 2026; vendor items are available for purchase.

cards.title: 7th & Q: Steam locomotive
cards.subtitle: Q Street corridor in the Historic Haymarket, west of UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Pause at the minipark to photograph the original steam locomotive and railcar, then continue through the brick-street Haymarket district on foot.
cards.short_summary: A small Haymarket park centered on a historic locomotive and railcar.
cards.evidence_claim: Bill Harris Iron Horse Park is a minipark near 7th and P in the Haymarket that includes an original steam locomotive and car.
cards.source_title: Historic Haymarket and Bill Harris Iron Horse Park
cards.access_notes: The listing identifies the park in the vicinity of 7th and P Street; verify any event-related access conditions locally.

cards.title: Canopy Street: Arena events
cards.subtitle: Canopy Street corridor in the Haymarket, west of UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Use the arena’s official event information to select a performance or game, then follow the event’s ticket, bag, and entry instructions.
cards.short_summary: A named Haymarket arena used for major Lincoln events.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Lincoln identifies Pinnacle Bank Arena as a Lincoln collegiate sports facility with a listed capacity of 15,000.
cards.source_title: Cities of The Big Ten | Visit Lincoln
cards.access_notes: Admission and access depend on the scheduled event; consult the venue’s official event details before going.

cards.title: 10th Street: Baseball setting
cards.subtitle: 10th Street corridor at the west edge of the Haymarket, near UNL City Campus
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled game or event at the stadium complex, which UNL’s current City Campus map labels as Haymarket Park Stadium Complex.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed stadium complex at the edge of the Haymarket.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL’s City Campus map labels Haymarket Park Stadium Complex and directs visitors to it from 10th Street and Q Street.
cards.access_notes: Venue entry and costs depend on the scheduled event; use the event organizer’s current information.
